title: The MOST Common Mistake Advertisers Make on Meta Ads
description: The MOST Common Mistake Advertisers Make on Meta Ads
transcript: What's the biggest mistake you see people making in meta ad campaigns? The most common mistake I see people making meta ad accounts is going to be people not being able to leave their ad accounts alone. Constantly tweaking and testing and putting an ad in here. When they do that, they never get out of learning phase. They never give meta time to stabilize campaigns. They see incredibly volatile results. They misattribute results to the changes they just made. And it could have nothing to do with that. Could have been that you were about to have a good day or a bad day anyway. So they're not making data driven decisions. We much better off just giving things more time, giving themselves an optimization schedule and saying I'm only gonna adjust my campaigns once every seven days or once every 10 days, something like that.
